2,766 matches, yet a ¥500 million business is still hard to build

A sports match is not automatically a payable project. Starting from 2,766 scheduled J.LEAGUE and B.LEAGUE regular-season matches, the essay separates match volume, video workflows, rights clearance, buyers, and actual paid contracts. It tests hypothetical routes to ¥100 million and ¥500 million in annual sales.
